goal: Wave 2 build: LoopGuard helper and gateway inline loop; Attention rail, shared FE vocabulary, tab badge; Typed notifications: capability-core, notification-core, native delivery; Decision scope once / thread / run

slices.title: LoopGuard helper and gateway inline loop
slices.summary: Adds a pure LoopGuard in mp-contracts that observes each tool round and returns Continue, Remind (at 3 and 5 repeats) or Stop (at 8 repeats, or on a cycle or no-progress pattern), and wires it into the gateway inline tool loop behind LOOP_GUARD_MODE with shadow as the default. The guard never executes or retries a tool; the content-free stop is persisted in run audit detail only.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p mp-contracts loop_guard
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p model-gateway duplicate_signature
slices.flag: LOOP_GUARD_MODE (model-gateway; off/shadow/enforce; unknown = shadow, observational label per K3-26)

slices.title: Attention rail, shared FE vocabulary, tab badge
slices.summary: Adds the shared attention vocabulary and the Waiting, Working and Unseen rail sections above the chat list, a chat.mark_thread_seen action, the tab title and badge count, and the BFF GET /api/v1/attention and POST /api/v1/attention/seen routes. The legacy run-status chip stays in place until S7.

slices.title: Decision scope once / thread / run
slices.summary: Adds approval_scope_grants and a standing release for eligible causes, so a this-thread or this-run approval lets the next identical operation proceed without a new pause. Grants are created in the decision transaction, are owner-bound, revocable and expiring, are erased with their thread, and are audited on each use. Eligibility is closed: provider writes, destructive, owner-effect and browser are ONCE only (K3-3). Thread TTL defaults to 3600 s with a 28800 s maximum.
test_commands: session-core tests: a_thread_grant_is_created_in_the_decision_transaction, a_grant_is_refused_for_an_ineligible_cause, a_replayed_decision_creates_one_grant, a_grant_expires, a_revoked_grant_is_not_matched, a_grant_in_another_thread_or_for_another_user_is_not_matched, grants_are_erased_with_the_thread, grants_flag_requires_audit_flag, a_child_agent_never_consumes_a_thread_grant (run the DB-gated ones with --ignored --test-threads=1 and DATABASE_URL set)
